WITH constructor_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    c.constructorId,
    c.nationality,
    COUNT(cs.constructorStandingsId) as record_count
  FROM constructors c
  LEFT JOIN constructorStandings cs ON c.constructorId = cs.constructorId
  GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.nationality
),
avg_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(record_count) as avg_records
  FROM constructor_counts
)
SELECT 
  cc.constructorId,
  cc.nationality,
  cc.record_count,
  (cc.record_count - ac.avg_records) as difference
FROM constructor_counts cc
CROSS JOIN avg_count ac
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10
